summary: --- name: Clawdbot description: Use when deploying and managing a self-hosted AI agent gateway, configuring messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage, etc.), building custom skills, setting up multi-agent routing, or troubleshooting agent behavior and channel connectivity. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # OpenClaw Skill Reference ## Product summary OpenClaw is a self-hosted WebSocket gateway that connects messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage, Slack, Signal, and more) to AI agents. A single Gateway process routes inbound messages to agents, manages sessions, executes tools, and delivers replies back to channels. Agents run the embedded Pi agent core with access to tools (browser, exec, web search, skills), memory, and multi-agent routing. Key files: `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` (config), `~/.openclaw/workspace/` (agent workspace with AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md, and skills/). Primary CLI: `openclaw` with subcommands for setup, config, agents, channels, skills, and gateway management. See the full docs at https://docs.openclaw.ai.
